The Domain Archaeology building is an industry that produces Domain-era artifacts based on the level of ruins on the planet. Setting this to false will disable crafting, and buildings that require Domain-era artifacts will no longer require them.

fieldName: Add Domain-tech buildings to several colonies
fieldDescription:
Replaces the Tech-Mining industry on Agreus with the Domain Archaeology industry, and adds several buildings that demand Domain-era artifacts to vanilla colonies.

This includes: Genelab on Volturn, Limelight Network on Fikenhild, GPA on Ancyra, Domain-era artifact demand on Cryosanctum on Nomios.

The Kletka Simulator is an industry that produces AI cores. The AI cores are sent to storage along with other items and ships the player receives each month.

fieldDescription: Set this to false to make the Kletka Simulator have a static upkeep cost instead of the upkeep cost being dependant on the temperature of the colony it is located on.

fieldDescription: Set this to true to make suppressing the temperature condition on a colony remove the Kletka Simulator's temperature-based upkeep modifier. For example, the Stellar Reflector Array can suppress hot and cold temperatures.
